newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money rates fluctuate on OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money rates fluctuate on OMO.

text.p: Pakistani money rates fluctuated due to a State (central) Bank of Pakistan weekly open market operation on Wednesday, dealers said.
They said rates were likely to stay high on Thursday on settlement of auctioned Federal Investment Bonds worth 1.38 billion rupees.
Morning deals took place at 12 and 13 percent before climbing to 14 percent due to borrowing pressure, a dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank, Karachi, said.
Rates later slipped to 6.00 percent and the market squared itself, he said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
